what: 3.2 Build exploitation parameters required by LIME
title: LIME tutorial
text: Unlike LB-SPR, LIME needs selectivity priors penalty constraint potential estimated values fishing mortality year year (Rudd Thorson, 2017). Rudd Thorson, 2017 therefore suggests calculate SL50 halfway length first one observed length composition mode. SL95 calculated SL50 * 1.15, fashion defined Prince et al., 2022 maturation ogive. fishing mortality prior, default 0.2 value taken (Rudd Thorson, 2017).
code: summary_catch <- catch_data$long %>%   dplyr::select(MeanLength, catch) %>%   dplyr::group_by(MeanLength) %>%   dplyr::summarise(total_catch = sum(catch)) catch_mode <- summary_catch$MeanLength[which.max(summary_catch$total_catch)] sl50 <- median(min(summary_catch$MeanLength):catch_mode) sel_params <- list(   sl50 = sl50,   sl95 = sl50 * 1.15 )  exploitation_params <- list(   s50 = sel_params$sl50,   s95 = sel_params$sl95,   sigmaF = 0.2 ) exploitation_params #> $s50 #> [1] 12.5 #>  #> $s95 #> [1] 14.375 #>  #> $sigmaF #> [1] 0.2

title: LIME tutorial
text: Lime, age-structured model, needs told whether provided selectivity maturity length age. Additionally, use data structure let LIME know steepness set h = 0.7
code: extra_lht_details <- list(   binwidth = 1,   selex_input = "length",   maturity_input = "length",   nseasons = 1,   nfleets = 1,   h = 0.7 )

title: LIME tutorial
text: Similar LB-SPR, LIME run flag simul set TRUE, population-dynamic simulation function triggered, providing following extra details time step: Observed catch--length Relative observed catch--length (catch divided maximum) Standardised age structure underlying fished population Standardised age structure underlying unfished population Standardised estimated catch--length result applying estimated selectivity estimated fished population
code: # Find SL50 and SL95 prior iim_lime_logistic <- lbmstoolbox::LimeLbms$new(   bio_params,   exploitation_params,   catch_data ) lht_context <- iim_lime_logistic$build_lht_context(extra_lht_details) result_lime <- iim_lime_logistic$run(lht_context, simul = TRUE)

title: LBMS Toolbox
text: toolbox integrates provides unified wrapper two widely-used length-based fisheries evaluation methods: LB-SPR (Hordyk et al., 2015a, 2015b, 2016) LIME (Rudd Thorson, 2017). also introduces several enhancements improve usability functionality, including: Streamlined Interface: models now share consistent interface, simplifying use integration. Full LB-SPR Features: addition generating standard estimates, LB-SPR now re-runs internal simulation function provide detailed outputs estimated fished unfished catch length composition, well corresponding population length structure. features already available model however wrapper exposes natural outputs. Modified LIME Features: version LIME used forked TMB template modified provide unfished population length structure. Likewise, wrapper LIME provides estimated fished catch length composition unfished one. Furthermore, fished unfished population length structures now outputs age domain, reflecting LIME’s fully age-structured modeling approach. features already inherent LIME, wrapper makes accessible standard outputs. Enhancing robustness results: Confidence intervals now included key evaluation metrics SPR FM LB-SPR SPR, F R LIME.
